svg.title: Women's share of ChatGPT messages in Norway, by topic and in total
svg.desc: Top panel: monthly share of messages from women in four topics, July 2024 to September 2026. All four rise. Bottom panel: the published total against a line that holds the topic mix fixed. The two lines rise by a similar amount. All values are in output/02_shift_share.csv and data/raw/norway_gender_topics_monthly.csv.
svg.text: Women's share of messages rose in every topic we can follow
ChatGPT messages in Norway from typically female first names, July 2024 to September 2026
Share of messages from women, by topic
Published total against a fixed topic mix
Top: a break is a month OpenAI withheld. It does not publish a value based on fewer than 100 messages,
to protect privacy. Bottom: gaps filled on a straight line, weights from topic_share_work_openai.
Panels use different vertical scales. Data: norway_gender_topics_monthly.csv, topics_expected_observed_persons.csv.
